author: Karthik_designs
prompt: Build a dark usage dashboard for an AI agent platform: a filter row, a KPI row (spend, runs, tokens, success rate, time saved), a stacked daily spend chart by model, and a tabbed per-model usage table.

author: ikramhsakib
prompt: Build the Metrics page of a light SaaS revenue analytics app: sidebar navigation, MRR, churn and failed-payment KPI cards, a monthly MRR bar chart with a revenue-movement summary beside it, and a filterable table of customer revenue movements.

author: ikramhsakib
prompt: Build the Connect page of a light revenue analytics app where a user links a billing source: sidebar navigation, a connector search, All / Not connected / Connected tabs, and a connected Stripe card with record counts, a read-only note, sync history and data health.

author: nizamdesign
prompt: Build an accounts-payable exception detail page for a VAT number mismatch on a supplier invoice: sidebar navigation, a status strip, an evidence card comparing the invoice VAT number with the verified record, an explanation, resolution options, and a side panel with priority reasons and supplier details.

author: nizamdesign
prompt: Build a client detail page for an AI advisory platform: sidebar navigation, a current-objective card with plan progress and three metrics, recent activity, open items that need action, and an account panel with plan, seats, AI usage and team.

author: sterlynavneet
prompt: Build a dark sales admin Customers page: sidebar with a Sales section, a row of five KPI cards, filter chips with table actions, a 13-row customer quotations table with priority and status, and pagination.

author: Karthik_designs
prompt: Build a dark Runs tab for one support agent called Escalation Watch: breadcrumb, agent header with status, Overview / Runs / Settings tabs, outcome filter chips with counts, and a list of eight ticket runs with their outcome. Show it zoomed in, cropped to the main content.

author: _heyrico
prompt: Build a light personal finance dashboard: sidebar navigation with an upgrade card, balance, income and expense cards, a monthly spending bar chart with one month highlighted, a transaction history table, and a right column with a payment card and savings.
